description: This file is a Markdown documentation page for configuring a Keystone 6 system. It provides detailed descriptions and code snippets related to configuring the Keystone framework, including sections on database setup, UI, server, sessions, GraphQL, schema extension, and more. The content is instructional and meant to guide users on how to set up and customize their Keystone application via TypeScript configuration files.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Main function to generate Keystone configuration object, accepting various options such as db, ui, server, graphql, etc.

methods.name: statelessSessions
methods.description: Function to create a session strategy in Keystone for stateless session management.

methods.name: extendGraphqlSchema
methods.description: Function to extend or modify the auto-generated GraphQL schema provided by Keystone.
